lines.note: This excludes Mejai's Soulstealer}} and Legendary items that can be upgraded such as all Support items, Vigilant Wardstone}}, and all Tear of the Goddess}} upgrades (Archangel's Staff}}, Manamune}}, Winter's Approach}}).

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Upon an item being upgraded into its Masterwork variant, it gains the (Masterwork|buzzword3) descriptor and has certain innate stats increased based on a table of values.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Statistics' gold value is represented by the following table, which also lists the ones which can be upgraded. This table also formally represents Riot's official stance on each statistic's gold efficiency, although not all stat types are included for the purposes of Masterwork items.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: /1 health, based on how many upgradeable stats exist on the item:

lines.label: Change
lines.note: # If the item has health only, health on that item is valued at per point (Ruby Crystal}} 150 health).

lines.label: Change
lines.note: # If the item has health and only one other upgradeable stat, health on that item is valued at per point.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: # If the item has health and two other upgradeable stats, health on that item is valued at per point (Ruby Crystal}} 150 health).

lines.label: Change
lines.note: # If the item has health and three other (or more) upgradeable stats, health on that item is valued at per point.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: While not currently possible, if an item has no upgradeable stats, worth of health will be added to the item.[https://www.reddit.com/r/leagueoflegends/comments/1d2g5g8/why_does_edge_of_finality_only_give_525_gold/l64is3z/?context=3 GalaxySmash on if an item has no upgradeable stats]

lines.label: Change
lines.note: The total gold value of all increased stats remains at . However, old Masterwork items only considered this value a general guideline (for the sake of cleaner numbers on the increased stats); the new upgraded items' value increases by precisely as a strict rule (according to the above table).

lines.label: Change
lines.note: All stats that are increased share equal gold value. For example, if an item has attack damage and attack speed, each upgraded stat will increase by of value; if an item has ability haste, armor, and magic resistance, each upgraded stat will increase by of value; etc.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Note that the values are rounded down in item tooltips, but are granted as normal.
